name: lynia-web-runtime
description: react-native-web for the customer web build of apps/mobile (EXPO_PUBLIC_LYNIA_WEB=1). Outside the pnpm workspace on purpose: adding it to apps/mobile renames the pnpm folders of expo-image, expo-router, expo-system-ui and react-native-maps (new peer), which moves the Android OTA fingerprint. Install with `npm ci` here.
